About.title: ABOUT
About.subtitle: Full-Stack, AI & Quality
About.tagline: I build complete products and make their AI reliable.
About.description:
Hi, I'm <span_bold>Zied Snoussi</span_bold>, a <span_bold>Full-Stack AI Engineer</span_bold> based in El Aouina, Tunis, with 3+ years of professional experience and in the final year of my software engineering degree at <span_bold>ESPRIT</span_bold>. Since 2024 I've worked remotely at <span_bold>Bysur</span_bold> (insurtech), on AI document verification and a multi-tenant SaaS platform.

<span_bold>🧱 Full-stack & architecture:</span_bold>
<span_bold>Next.js</span_bold>, <span_bold>React</span_bold>, <span_bold>Angular</span_bold> and <span_bold>Flutter</span_bold> on the front; <span_bold>NestJS</span_bold>, <span_bold>Node.js</span_bold> and <span_bold>Spring Boot</span_bold> on the back, with <span_bold>PostgreSQL</span_bold>, <span_bold>MongoDB</span_bold>, <span_bold>Redis</span_bold>, <span_bold>Keycloak</span_bold> and <span_bold>Kafka</span_bold>. I've designed microservices (Spring Cloud, database per service) and modular monoliths in academic and personal projects.

<span_bold>🤖 AI & agents:</span_bold>
I use <span_bold>Claude</span_bold> every day (<span_bold>Claude Pro</span_bold>, <span_bold>Claude Enterprise</span_bold> and <span_bold>Claude Code</span_bold>) and I'm following Anthropic's courses on Claude for enterprise. I build agents with the <span_bold>Claude Agent SDK</span_bold> and <span_bold>MCP</span_bold>, <span_bold>LangChain</span_bold> / <span_bold>LangGraph</span_bold> assistants and <span_bold>RAG</span_bold> pipelines, and I measure them with evals (<span_bold>RAGAS</span_bold>, mutation testing). Local and hosted models through <span_bold>Ollama</span_bold> and <span_bold>LiteLLM</span_bold>.

<span_bold>📊 Machine learning & MLOps:</span_bold>
<span_bold>scikit-learn</span_bold>, <span_bold>XGBoost</span_bold> and <span_bold>Pandas</span_bold> for models; <span_bold>MLflow</span_bold>, <span_bold>Prefect</span_bold> and the ELK stack to track and run them; <span_bold>dbt</span_bold> and <span_bold>Airflow</span_bold> for data warehouses.

<span_bold>⚙️ DevOps & quality:</span_bold>
<span_bold>Docker</span_bold>, <span_bold>Kubernetes</span_bold>, <span_bold>GitHub Actions</span_bold> and <span_bold>Jenkins</span_bold> pipelines with <span_bold>SonarQube</span_bold>, <span_bold>Trivy</span_bold> and <span_bold>Playwright</span_bold> quality gates, monitored with <span_bold>Prometheus</span_bold> and <span_bold>Grafana</span_bold>. I work in <span_bold>VS Code</span_bold> and <span_bold>IntelliJ IDEA</span_bold>, with Git and GitHub.

bysur.title: Full Stack Developer
bysur.description:
• Bysur Suites (since July 2026): integrating the company's insurance products into one multi-tenant SaaS platform (modular monolith with NestJS, tRPC, Drizzle and PostgreSQL; React and Angular consoles).
• Created the shared @bysur UI library and design system (Storybook, private registry, versioned releases) used across the products.
• Bysur Verify (Doki): built features of an AI document-verification SaaS for insurers with Next.js and OpenAI: LLM-based document checks, workspaces with role-based access (RBAC) and document management.
• Bysur Cancel: built the contract-cancellation product end to end in a Turborepo monorepo, now in production.
• Insurance CRM: designed a dynamic form builder with conditional logic and case-file tracking (Payload CMS, React), with payment and third-party API integrations.
• Developed a modular NestJS + Drizzle insurance API (Passport auth, templated e-mails, Jest tests) and shipped TheGuestbook, a 3-app hospitality platform (50+ endpoints, Stripe, 5 languages).
• Improved the performance of the Assurno React Native / Expo app.
• Quality gates in CI (Jenkins, SonarQube, Playwright) and daily AI-assisted development with Claude Code, in a remote team.

rooly.title: Full Stack Developer
rooly.description:
• Built AD Eyes, a shrimp-farm management platform for Aqua Development Ltd., with three role-based apps: Admin (farms, managers, parameters, supplies), Farm Manager (ponds, feeding programs, technicians) and Technician (daily checks on water and shrimp health).
• Backend with NestJS and MongoDB: 36 controllers, 39 schemas, JWT, rate limiting, Redis caching, AWS S3 file storage and invitation e-mails.
• Frontend with Next.js 14 as an installable web app (PWA): Redux Toolkit, ApexCharts, Google Maps, CSRF protection, English / Arabic / Korean.
• Delivered the client's corporate website (Next.js, Framer Motion, Mapbox).
• Wrote weekly and technical reports: PWA for tablets, authorization methods, data migration, front-end refactoring.

msg.title: Full Stack Developer
msg.description:
• Built, on my own, the catalogue and e-commerce website of a Tunisian food exporter (fish, vegetables and fruit), still live and maintained.
• Customer side: multilingual pages, product catalogue and categories, contact forms.
• Back office: products, categories, featured products, messages, users and settings, with JWT authentication.
• First version in React, Node.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL on a VPS; current version in Next.js and MongoDB on Vercel.

ipLabel.title: Web Developer Intern
ipLabel.description:
• Built an internal platform for the load-testing team (Ekara by ip-label): a central library of test scripts with access control, a scheduling calendar, a script editor and PDF reports (React, Redux, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL).
• Ran load-testing campaigns with k6, JMeter and Selenium and followed the results in Grafana.
• Wrote guides on integrating Selenium into WebLOAD and on advanced JMeter use; designed the interfaces in Figma.

b2s.title: Web Developer Intern
b2s.description:
• Built STAR SHOP, an e-commerce website, with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js).
• Full order flow: catalogue and search, cart, shipping address on Google Maps, PayPal payment, invoices and order history.
• Admin panel for products, users, orders and deliveries.
